prompt: Create a cinematic, photorealistic split-screen café scene showing the same stylish young man in two surreal coffee moments, divided by a clean vertical split down the center. Left side: the man sits at an outdoor European sidewalk café on a sunny city street, wearing a crisp white button-up shirt, with dark hair tied in a loose high bun, facing the camera with a calm serious expression. He holds an oversized white ceramic cup with both hands; inside is creamy latte with a detailed white leaf latte-art pattern, and a dramatic frozen splash of caramel-brown coffee erupts upward from the cup in a crown shape with many droplets suspended in midair. Show café tables, chairs, awnings, tall Paris-like buildings, warm afternoon sunlight, and shallow depth of field. Right side: the same man appears seated inside or at the edge of a cozy modern café, wearing a dark brown knit sweater and black sunglasses, hair short and slicked back, also facing the camera with a composed expression. He holds an oversized muted green ceramic cup with both hands; inside is frothy green matcha latte, and a vibrant green liquid splash bursts upward in a crown shape with droplets frozen around it. The background includes a wooden café table, large window, blurred city street, indoor shelves, plants, pendant lamps, and warm bokeh lighting. Use hyper-realistic skin texture, natural hands, realistic liquid physics, rich cinematic contrast, warm golden tones on the left and darker cozy café tones on the right, 16:9 landscape composition, sharp focus on the man and cups, blurred background, no text, no logo, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一个电影级、写实风格的分屏咖啡馆场景，通过中间清晰的垂直分割线，展示同一位时尚年轻男子在两个超现实咖啡时刻的画面。左侧：男子坐在阳光明媚的城市街道旁，身处欧式露天咖啡馆，身穿 白色衬衫，留着 深色高丸子头，面朝镜头，表情冷静严肃。他双手捧着一个超大白色陶瓷杯；杯中是奶油拿铁，表面有精致的白色拉花，焦糖色的咖啡呈现出戏剧性的凝固飞溅效果，向上形成皇冠状，许多液滴悬浮在半空中。画面包含咖啡桌、椅子、遮阳篷、类似巴黎的高大建筑、温暖的午后阳光以及浅景深效果。右侧：同一名男子出现在舒适现代的咖啡馆内或边缘，身穿 深棕色针织毛衣并佩戴黑色墨镜，短发向后梳理，同样面朝镜头，表情沉稳。他双手捧着一个超大哑光绿色陶瓷杯；杯中是泡沫丰富的 抹茶拿铁，鲜艳的绿色液体向上喷溅形成皇冠状，周围环绕着凝固的液滴。背景包括木质咖啡桌、大窗户、模糊的城市街道、室内货架、植物、吊灯和温暖的焦外成像光效。使用超写实皮肤纹理、自然的双手、逼真的液体物理效果、丰富的电影级对比度，左侧采用温暖的金色调，右侧采用较暗的舒适咖啡馆色调，16:9 横向构图，焦点清晰对准男子和杯子，背景虚化，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。
